pericopes.title: Before Pilate
pericopes.imageAlt: An official stone tribunal platform with a single carved chair, empty, morning light on the pale stone steps

pericopes.title: Before Herod
pericopes.imageAlt: An elaborate royal garment laid out on a stone floor, costly but empty, beside a plain dark shadow cast by nothing visible

pericopes.title: Pilate's Verdict
pericopes.imageAlt: A stone judicial tablet with a wax seal broken and hanging open, the document sealed and then unsealable

pericopes.title: The Road to the Cross
pericopes.imageAlt: A narrow stone street between high walls, the stones worn smooth by the passage of countless feet, the street ending in darkness

pericopes.title: The Crucifixion
pericopes.imageAlt: A bare rocky hilltop at harsh noon, three post-holes in the pale bedrock, the sky overexposed and white, no objects

pericopes.title: The Death of Jesus
pericopes.imageAlt: A total solar eclipse mid-day, the corona visible, the landscape below in unnatural darkness, everything washed gray

pericopes.title: The Burial
pericopes.imageAlt: A large circular stone partially rolled aside from a dark tomb entrance, late afternoon light on the pale stone, deep shadow within
